description: This header file declares functions related to parsing and registering JSON schemas for WiFi data models and data elements. It includes callback definitions, function prototypes for parsing JSON schemas, and support for WFA Data Elements and native WiFi data models, facilitating their registration with a bus system.

methods.name: parse_json_schema_and_register
methods.description: Parses a JSON schema file and registers data model elements with the bus system, handling references, schema features, and type inference.

methods.name: parse_and_register_wfa_schema
methods.description: Parses and registers WFA Data Elements JSON schema under the specified namespace.

methods.name: parse_and_register_native_dml_schema
methods.description: Parses and registers native WiFi data model JSON schema; included only if ONEWIFI_JSON_DML_SUPPORT is defined.
